locallyExecutableCloseout.finding: The remaining concrete coverage is not missing art mapping or an identified broken pose. It is 19 actor-specific event-state holes in retained actual-encounter traces: 9 actors have no execute/recover observation; 10 have no recover observation. The per-ID forced clips already exist for all 30 actors and should be reused for pose inspection.
locallyExecutableCloseout.boundedAction: One gap-only technical batch for those 19 actors, each on a fresh QA UUID using existing battle fixtures and ordinary engine event dispatch (no forced state requests). For the 9 execute+recover gaps, choose a low-damage owned/fixture profile that lets the enemy take one real turn; for the 10 recover-only gaps, capture the first eligible recovery after the already-observed execute. Save one short full-battle segment or marker-bound transition window plus trace per case. Reuse all existing 11 fully covered actors and four R01/R05 runs; do not recapture them.
passCriteria: For every gap actor, target event is present in event log and joins to that actor ID, action root, scene generation, and actual rendered state-frame rows.
For execute, at least one complete multi-frame execute interval precedes the corresponding hit/next action; for recover, actual recover rows appear after execute without substituting resolve.
Visual sample at beginning/middle/end of each joined interval shows stable bounds, no disappearance/crop, and identity/weapon silhouette readable at phone scale.

If the state is not reached after the one real encounter, mark it conditionally-unobserved with the actual event path; do not convert forced-state reads into natural-event proof or change combat values to force a pass.
locallyExecutableCloseout.scopeCap: 19 gap cases only, one capture attempt per case, ≤20 min total batch with bounded clip/output caps copied from current R407/R418 runner contracts. No artwork changes unless this gap-only review exposes a reproducible visual defect; formal art adoption remains separate.

conclusion: For the four allies, existing evidence covers each state category at least once and sampled hit imagery for each actor; a new capture is not justified by missing-state evidence. For enemies, all 30 have mapped states and forced-state clips, but actual encounter-trace union has seven-state evidence for only 11/30. The finite remaining technical review is the 19-row execute/recover gap listed in enemyByID. R418 closes its one confirmed B_R05_B execute interruption issue for that case; it does not close the other gaps or prove all-enemy naturalness.
